Name: Scholar's Journal
Author: Nicolas2489
Description:
A two-year slow-burn story told entirely through letters. A mysterious scholar begins writing to you about the valley's magical secrets — clinical, distant, clearly knowledgeable.
Across sixteen letters the wall comes down, clues accumulate, and by Winter Year 2 you know exactly who they are without ever being told directly.
✦ Features
16 letters across two years — delivered every other week, never missing
Year 1: clinical distance that slowly cracks. 'I had a farm once.' 'I left in spring, twenty-three years ago.'
Year 2: the wall comes down. A land registry connects their family to your grandfather's. They admit they can see your farm from the ridge.Clues build across every letter — never stated directly, always earned
Year 2 Fall: stops signing A.F.V. Signs 'E.' instead
Final letter — Winter Year 2, Winter 25 — full name, full story, the Harvest Token explained, 2000g
Ties into Seasonal Secrets — the Scholar who sent foraging hints had a reason to care
Edmund Fairvale. Son of Elias. He farmed next to your grandfather for thirty years.
⚙ Requirements
Content Patcher 2.8.0+📦
Installation
Download and unzip the mod folder.Drop the folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods/ directory.Launch the game through SMAPI.💡 Note: Install Seasonal Secrets alongside this mod. The Harvest Token found on Fall 25 is retroactively explained in the final letter.

Downloads.Description: Main mod file. Extract and drop the TheScholarsJournal folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods/ directory. Requires Farm Type Manager — items referenced in letters will appear at their hinted locations on the correct dates. Start a new save for better exp.
